name: com.uee03.pretzel.cloud
description: Unity Gaming Services for Pretzel: Authentication, Cloud Save, Cloud Code and Remote Config behind SDK-free interfaces, plus an offline-first cloud save store for Pretzel Data with retry, a persistent upload queue and conflict resolution. Each adapter assembly compiles only when its Unity package is installed.

samples.description: Signs in anonymously and saves and loads a profile through the offline-first synced store, with a sync status label. Needs the Authentication and Cloud Save packages.
Calls a Cloud Code module endpoint and reads Remote Config values with typed defaults. Needs the Authentication, Cloud Code and Remote Config packages.
Uses the cloud interfaces with in-memory fakes and a temp-folder local store, so a game runs and tests offline without any Unity Gaming Services package.
